page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.xlarge is a virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 processor architecture. It is equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 ratio of vCPUs to RAM with 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance carries no local disk storage and contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators. Networking configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation reflects a standard general-purpose computing resource profile. Dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable processing capability without shared-core contention. Because local storage is absent, persistent data operations rely entirely on attached remote block storage options. The instance is suited for general-purpose enterprise tasks, mid-tier application hosting, continuous integration worker nodes, and multi-threaded backend services.
